decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 13th October 2005, that the erection of a single storey rear extension with staggered rear building line, to measure 5.7m wide where it meets the house, increasing by 0.42m width towards the rear; to measure 2.5m depth on the eastern flank, 3.9m deep on the western flank, 3.6m maximum height and 2.2m height at the eaves with a volume of 57.1m3, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

Condition : 2 - Informative: The dimensions of the part-built extension found on site do not accord with the drawings submitted. If it is the applicant's intention to retain the structure as erected, the Local Planning Authority would recommend that a new application for a certificate of lawfulness is submitted with accurate scaled drawings.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to house
